description: Table of contents for one Hong Kong law: every section number and heading, in order, paged. Use to browse a law's structure before reading a specific section with hk_law_section, or to enumerate every section number a long Ordinance has. Returns has_more and next_offset when the law has more sections than the page size.

cap.description: Chapter number (from hk_law_search or hk_law_info), e.g. "486" or "486A".

title.description: English or Traditional Chinese title, used when cap is not known.

name: hk_law_toc
title: Hk Law Toc
